def list2d(a, b, c): return [[c for j in range(b)] for i in range(a)]
def list3d(a, b, c, d): return [[[d for k in range(c)] for j in range(b)] for i in range(a)]

def ceil(x, y=1): return int(-(-x // y))
def INT(): return int(input())

class Dinic {

    int INF = 10_000_000_000;

    public Dinic(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        this.links = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            links[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        this.depth = null;
        this.progress = null;
        this.pos = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    public Dinic copy() {
        Dinic res = new Dinic(n);
        res.links = new ArrayList[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res.links[i] = new ArrayList<>(links[i]);
        }
        res.pos = new ArrayList<>(pos);
        return res;
    }

    public void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
        pos.add(new int[]{from, links[from].size()});
        links[from].add(new int[]{cap, to, links[to].size()});
        links[to].add(new int[]{0, from, links[from].size() - 1});
    }

    public void bfs(int s) {
        int[] depth = new int[n];
        depth[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int[] link : links[v]) {
                if (link[0] > 0 && depth[link[1]] < 0) {
                    depth[link[1]] = depth[v] + 1;
                    q.add(link[1]);
                }
            }
        }
        this.depth = depth;
    }

    public int dfs(int v, int t, int flow) {
        if (v == t) {
            return flow;
        }
        ArrayList<int[]> links_v = links[v];
        for (int i = progress.get(v); i < links_v.size(); i++) {
            progress.set(v, i + 1);
            int[] link = links_v.get(i);
            if (link[0] == 0 || depth[v] >= depth[link[1]]) {
                continue;
            }
            int d = dfs(link[1], t, Math.min(flow, link[0]));
            if (d == 0) {
                continue;
            }
            link[0] -= d;
            links[link[1]][link[2]][0] += d;
            return d;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public int flow(int s, int t) {
        int INF = Dinic.INF;
        int flow = 0;
        while (true) {
            bfs(s);
            if (depth[t] < 0) {
                return flow;
            }
            progress = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                progress.add(0);
            }
            int currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
            while (currentFlow > 0) {
                flow += currentFlow;
                currentFlow = dfs(s, t, INF);
            }
        }
    }

    public int[] getEdge(int i) {
        int[] e = links[pos.get(i)][pos.get(i)[1]];
        int[] re = links[e[1]][e[2]];
        // from, to, cap, flow
        return new int[]{pos.get(i)[0], e[1], e[0] + re[0], re[0]};
    }

    public int[][] getEdges() {
        int M = pos.size();
        int[][] res = new int[M][4];
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            res[i] = getEdge(i);
        }
        return res;
    }

    int n;
    ArrayList<int[]>[] links;
    int[] depth;
    ArrayList<Integer> progress;
    ArrayList<int[]> pos;
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = scanner.nextInt();
        int M = 3;
        int[] A = new int[M];
        int[] B = new int[M];
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            A[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            B[i] = scanner.nextInt();
        }
        int ans1 = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            ans1 += Math.min(A[i], B[(i + 1) % M]);
        }
        int ans2 = 0;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(2 * M + 2);
        int s = 2 * M;
        int t = 2 * M + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            // s to Alice
            dinic.addEdge(s, i, N);
            // Bob to t
            dinic.addEdge(M + i, t, B[i]);
            // draw
            dinic.addEdge(i, M + i, A[i]);
            // Alice lose
            dinic.addEdge(i, M + (i - 1) % M, A[i]);
        }
        ans2 = N - dinic.flow(s, t);
        System.out.println(ans2 + " " + ans1);
    }
}
